answer_1.quote: Building upon this benchmark, we introduce two complementary tasks: (1) Feature-centric opinion extraction (FOE) ... (2) Opinion-centric insight generation (OIG) assesses whether LLMs can mine high-level topics and insights from user opinions expressed in online content.
answer_1.outputs: Free-form opinion-centric insights organizing opinions into high-level topics

answer_2.quote: To evaluate structured opinion extraction capabilities of LLMs, we utilize three types of tuple matching evaluation methods... For semantic evaluation, we leverage BERTScore (BS)... For both ROUGE and A3CU, we report F1 scores.

answer_3.quote: Moreover, to ensure a systematic and comprehensive evaluation, we also conduct reference-free assessments using an LLM-as-a judge. Inspired by , we design the following six well-defined criteria: Faithfulness, Coverage, Specificity, Insightfulness, Intent and Fluency.

answer_4.quote: We assess the quality of the generated insight through a human evaluation conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT). Specifically, we randomly sample 200 examples... Each judge rates the quality of the insights on a 1 to 5 scale across six criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Rated on 1-5 scale across six criteria
